collectionMethods.note: Three ways data reaches a snapshot. Browser-capture was added 2026-09-22 and is what unblocked TikTok/Instagram/X/Threads.
collectionMethods.server: stdlib fetchers — fetch_appstore / fetch_googleplay / fetch_google_trends / fetch_social_public / fetch_youtube.
collectionMethods.browserCapture: Read the PUBLIC profile in a real browser, then record via: python scripts/import_social_csv.py --date <d> --csv <file> --source 'browser-capture (public profile, <d>)'. Most public counts are ROUNDED — record followersPrecision so WoW growth below that granularity is never over-read.
collectionMethods.export: Hootsuite/Buffer analytics export → canonical CSV → import_social_csv.py. Still the ONLY route to impressions/reach/shares/engagement.

rules: Every metric must carry a collection period + capture date.
Raw platform data first; any estimate must be labelled as an estimate.
Google Trends is a RELATIVE index — never state it as absolute search volume.
Never sum across different markets/platforms/account types unless the definition is identical.
Present follower growth, exposure, views and engagement rate separately — no metric substitutes for another.
Never fabricate competitors, owners, amounts, deadlines or data to fill the board — mark gaps explicitly.
For any anomaly, re-check the collection method first, then give a business explanation (verified vs hypothesis).
